# Vendored libraries (installed from npm, not edited)

| Library | Version | Files | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| GSAP (core, ScrollTrigger, SplitText) | 3.15.1 | `gsap/` | GSAP Standard "no charge" licence, free including commercial use (https://gsap.com/standard-license) |
| Lenis (smooth scroll) | 1.3.27 | `lenis/` | MIT |

Three.js 0.187.0 is not vendored. It loads from the jsDelivr CDN (`assets/js/config.js` → `threeUrl`).

These are the libraries' readable (unminified) builds, so every file in the site is unminified.
